# Component props and events

Import `TopoViewer` and its types from `topoviewer`, and its required CSS from `topoviewer/style.css`. The prop signatures below are generated from the public TypeScript declarations; behavior notes are reviewed alongside the runtime.

Start with the [React quickstart](../examples/use-cases/react.md). This reference follows [development documentation](../start/documentation-versions.md); check the release notes when adopting a new option.

## Props

### document

Required composed runtime document. Portable sources keep topology and stylesheet separate; compose and validate them before rendering.

```ts
document: TopoDocument;
```

### colorMode

Explicit light or dark renderer theme. Defaults to dark; documentation adapters follow their host theme.

```ts
colorMode?: TopoViewerColorMode;
```

### theme

Partial semantic theme-token override. Keep status and focus colors consistent and accessible.

```ts
theme?: Partial<TopoViewerThemeTokens>;
```

### selectedLayerIds

Controlled visible layer IDs. Omission selects every declared layer; an empty array hides all layered objects.

```ts
selectedLayerIds?: string[];
```

### selectedObjectIds

Controlled selection using stable source IDs. Update from onSelectionChange when the application owns selection.

```ts
selectedObjectIds?: string[];
```

### previewObjectIds

Source IDs to highlight as a transient preview without committing selection.

```ts
previewObjectIds?: string[];
```

### initialViewport

Initial x/y translation and zoom. Used on mount; it is not a controlled viewport prop.

```ts
initialViewport?: TopoViewerViewport;
```

### nodesDraggable

Set false for a read-only view. Dragging is enabled unless disabled and only after layout is ready; persist positions through callbacks.

```ts
nodesDraggable?: boolean;
```

### nodesResizable

Enable visual resize handles for authoring. Persist accepted dimensions and source positions in the host.

```ts
nodesResizable?: boolean;
```

### nodesConnectable

Set true to expose connection creation. Disabled unless explicitly enabled; connections still need host validation and persistence.

```ts
nodesConnectable?: boolean;
```

### nodesFocusable

Allow node keyboard traversal. Keep enabled for accessible read-only diagrams.

```ts
nodesFocusable?: boolean;
```

### edgesFocusable

Allow edge keyboard traversal. Keep enabled when readers need to inspect relationships.

```ts
edgesFocusable?: boolean;
```

### disableKeyboardA11y

Disable the underlying graph keyboard accessibility behavior. Keep false or omitted for normal reader-facing diagrams.

```ts
disableKeyboardA11y?: boolean;
```

### onlyRenderVisibleElements

Limit mounted graph elements to the visible viewport. Evaluate accessibility and interaction implications before enabling.

```ts
onlyRenderVisibleElements?: boolean;
```

### panOnDrag

Control pointer panning, or restrict it to specified mouse buttons. Coordinate this with host selection tools.

```ts
panOnDrag?: boolean | number[];
```

### selectionOnDrag

Enable box selection while dragging on empty canvas. Use selectionMode to define enclosure behavior.

```ts
selectionOnDrag?: boolean;
```

### selectionMode

Box-selection policy: full enclosure or partial overlap. Omission uses full enclosure.

```ts
selectionMode?: 'partial' | 'full';
```

### connectionHandleMode

Connection anchor mode: full-node, explicit handles, or shape handles. Defaults to full-node.

```ts
connectionHandleMode?: 'full-node' | 'handles' | 'shape-handles';
```

### helperLines

Boolean or alignment/snapping configuration for draggable authoring views. This is runtime state, not YAML.

```ts
helperLines?: boolean | TopoViewerHelperLinesOptions;
```

### toggles

Runtime display-switch values. Override the document-defined initial view without rewriting source facts.

```ts
toggles?: TopoViewerToggles;
```

### layout

Runtime layout override. Supply supported manual, force, CLOS, or tree configuration.

```ts
layout?: LayoutConfig;
```

### attention

Runtime focus query or precomputed presentation. Focus changes visibility/emphasis and does not mutate source topology.

```ts
attention?: {
    query?: FocusQuery;
    presentation?: AttentionPresentationResult;
  };
```

### extensions

Ordered compiler/render extensions. Each extension names its boundary and may supply supported custom node or edge types.

```ts
extensions?: TopoViewerExtension[];
```

### controlPanelToggle

Host settings-panel button configuration: enabled, open state, and onToggle callback. The host owns the panel content.

```ts
controlPanelToggle?: {
    enabled?: boolean;
    open?: boolean;
    onToggle?: () => void;
  };
```

### fitViewOnInit

Explicit initial-fit policy. Omission fits when no initialViewport is supplied.

```ts
fitViewOnInit?: boolean;
```

### fitViewRequestId

Change this value to request another fit after initialization. Reusing the same value does not request a new fit.

```ts
fitViewRequestId?: string | number;
```

### grid

Show the grid, hide it with false, or supply color, gap, and dot size. Omission shows the grid.

```ts
grid?: boolean | TopoViewerGridOptions;
```

### miniMap

Enable an interactive overview minimap. Omission leaves it hidden.

```ts
miniMap?: boolean;
```

### viewportControls

Hide controls with false, or configure position, zoom/fit actions, fit options, and custom children.

```ts
viewportControls?: boolean | TopoViewerViewportControlsOptions;
```

### onObjectClick

Click payload includes source id, opaque runtimeId, element kind, data, and optional modifier keys. Use source id for domain joins.

```ts
onObjectClick?: (object: TopoViewerObjectClick) => void;
```

### onObjectDoubleClick

Double-click payload extends the object payload with client coordinates. The host decides whether to open an editor.

```ts
onObjectDoubleClick?: (object: TopoViewerObjectDoubleClick) => void;
```

### onObjectContextMenu

Object context-menu payload includes client coordinates. The host owns the menu and action policy.

```ts
onObjectContextMenu?: (object: TopoViewerObjectContextMenu) => void;
```

### onSelectionContextMenu

Context-menu payload includes the selected object list and client coordinates.

```ts
onSelectionContextMenu?: (selection: TopoViewerSelectionContextMenu) => void;
```

### onSelectionChange

Receives { objects }, including stable identities and object semantics. Update controlled selection from those source IDs.

```ts
onSelectionChange?: (selection: TopoViewerSelectionChange) => void;
```

### onPaneClick

Empty-canvas click includes client and graph coordinates, viewport, and optional modifiers. Useful for clearing selection or inserting an object.

```ts
onPaneClick?: (event: TopoViewerPaneClick) => void;
```

### onNodePositionChange

Committed single-object movement, including source id, runtimeId, position, data, and optional delta. Persist through a host transaction.

```ts
onNodePositionChange?: (change: TopoViewerNodePositionChange) => void;
```

### onNodesPositionChange

Batch of committed movements, for example dragging a multi-selection. Persist the batch atomically.

```ts
onNodesPositionChange?: (changes: TopoViewerNodePositionChange[]) => void;
```

### onNodePositionPreview

Transient movement preview. Avoid persisting each pointer event as a committed source change.

```ts
onNodePositionPreview?: (change: TopoViewerNodePositionChange) => void;
```

### onNodeResizeChange

Accepted resize includes id, runtimeId, position, width/height size, and object data. Persist topology position and stylesheet dimensions separately.

```ts
onNodeResizeChange?: (change: TopoViewerNodeResizeChange) => void;
```

### onRegionAggregateToggle

Region-summary expansion request includes regionId, groupId, expanded, and data. The host controls the resulting aggregate state.

```ts
onRegionAggregateToggle?: (change: TopoViewerRegionAggregateToggle) => void;
```

### onLinkAggregateToggle

Parallel-link group request includes groupId, expanded, memberIds, and data. Keep the underlying source links intact.

```ts
onLinkAggregateToggle?: (change: TopoViewerLinkAggregateToggle) => void;
```

### onConnectionCreate

Connection request includes source/target source IDs, runtime IDs, and optional handle IDs. The host creates and validates the source link.

```ts
onConnectionCreate?: (connection: TopoViewerConnectionCreate) => void;
```

### isConnectionValid

Return a boolean for a proposed connection. Reject unsupported endpoint/handle combinations before the host creates a link.

```ts
isConnectionValid?: (connection: TopoViewerConnectionCreate) => boolean;
```

### onViewportChange

Receives x, y, and zoom after viewport changes. Store under the topology identity to restore that view on a later mount.

```ts
onViewportChange?: (viewport: TopoViewerViewport) => void;
```

### onExport

Callback for the viewport export action. The host chooses format, destination, and error handling.

```ts
onExport?: () => void;
```

### emptyFallback

React content or callback for empty and filtered-empty render states. Explain how the reader can return to a populated view.

```ts
emptyFallback?: ReactNode | ((state: Exclude<TopoRenderState, 'ready'>) => ReactNode);
```

### errorFallback

React content or callback receiving structured diagnostics. Replace the default error UI while retaining actionable messages.

```ts
errorFallback?: ReactNode | ((diagnostics: readonly TopoViewerDiagnostic[]) => ReactNode);
```

### onDiagnostics

Receives structured renderer diagnostics. Log or display their code, severity, and message without exposing sensitive source data.

```ts
onDiagnostics?: (diagnostics: readonly TopoViewerDiagnostic[]) => void;
```

### exportDisabled

Disable the export action while the host cannot export safely, such as during a pending operation.

```ts
exportDisabled?: boolean;
```

### exportTooltip

Host-supplied export-button explanation, including why export is disabled when relevant.

```ts
exportTooltip?: string;
```

### className

Class on the renderer wrapper. Scope host CSS so it does not alter graph geometry accidentally.

```ts
className?: string;
```

### style

Wrapper CSS properties. Give the viewport a definite height and a usable width.

```ts
style?: CSSProperties;
```

## Event payloads and option objects

The payload declarations distinguish stable source identity from renderer identity. Treat `runtimeId` as opaque. Callbacks report changes; the host owns persistence, validation, and undo.

### TopoViewerObjectClick

```ts
interface TopoViewerObjectClick {
  id: string;
  runtimeId: string;
  element: 'node' | 'edge' | 'linkDirection';
  data: Record<string, unknown>;
  modifiers?: {
    ctrlKey: boolean;
    metaKey: boolean;
    shiftKey: boolean;
  };
}
```

### TopoViewerObjectContextMenu

```ts
interface TopoViewerObjectContextMenu extends TopoViewerObjectClick {
  clientX: number;
  clientY: number;
}
```

### TopoViewerObjectDoubleClick

```ts
interface TopoViewerObjectDoubleClick extends TopoViewerObjectClick {
  clientX: number;
  clientY: number;
}
```

### TopoViewerSelectionChange

```ts
interface TopoViewerSelectionChange {
  objects: TopoViewerObjectClick[];
}
```

### TopoViewerSelectionContextMenu

```ts
interface TopoViewerSelectionContextMenu extends TopoViewerSelectionChange {
  clientX: number;
  clientY: number;
}
```

### TopoViewerViewport

```ts
interface TopoViewerViewport {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  zoom: number;
}
```

### TopoViewerNodePositionChange

```ts
interface TopoViewerNodePositionChange {
  delta?: { x: number; y: number };
  id: string;
  runtimeId: string;
  position: { x: number; y: number };
  data: Record<string, unknown>;
}
```

### TopoViewerNodeResizeChange

```ts
interface TopoViewerNodeResizeChange {
  id: string;
  runtimeId: string;
  position: { x: number; y: number };
  size: { width: number; height: number };
  data: Record<string, unknown>;
}
```

### TopoViewerRegionAggregateToggle

```ts
interface TopoViewerRegionAggregateToggle {
  regionId: string;
  groupId: string;
  expanded: boolean;
  data: Record<string, unknown>;
}
```

### TopoViewerLinkAggregateToggle

```ts
interface TopoViewerLinkAggregateToggle {
  groupId: string;
  expanded: boolean;
  memberIds: string[];
  data: Record<string, unknown>;
}
```

### TopoViewerConnectionCreate

```ts
interface TopoViewerConnectionCreate {
  sourceId: string;
  sourceRuntimeId: string;
  sourceHandleId?: string;
  targetId: string;
  targetRuntimeId: string;
  targetHandleId?: string;
}
```

### TopoViewerPaneClick

```ts
interface TopoViewerPaneClick {
  clientX: number;
  clientY: number;
  position: { x: number; y: number };
  viewport: TopoViewerViewport;
  modifiers?: {
    ctrlKey: boolean;
    metaKey: boolean;
    shiftKey: boolean;
  };
}
```

### TopoViewerHelperLinesOptions

```ts
interface TopoViewerHelperLinesOptions {
  enabled?: boolean;
  snap?: boolean;
  snapMode?: 'live' | 'commit';
  snapHysteresis?: number;
  threshold?: number;
  showMidpoints?: boolean;
  candidateLimit?: number;
  midpointCandidateLimit?: number;
}
```

### TopoViewerViewportControlsOptions

```ts
interface TopoViewerViewportControlsOptions {
  children?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  fitViewOptions?: FitViewOptions;
  position?: 'top-left' | 'top-center' | 'top-right' | 'bottom-left' | 'bottom-center' | 'bottom-right';
  showFitView?: boolean;
  showZoom?: boolean;
}
```

### TopoViewerGridOptions

```ts
interface TopoViewerGridOptions {
  color?: string;
  gap?: number;
  size?: number;
}
```
